verdict.rationale: Zero is an AI email app, and an official CLI is a fair question for such a product, so the axis applies. The pack documents no user-facing CLI: the only commands are contributor and dev scripts (`pnpm go`, `pnpm nizzy env`, `pnpm db:studio`, `pnpm test:ai`) for setting up and running the repo. The MCP server documented in MCP.md belongs to a separate story and is not credited here.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can use an official CLI
